units.source_text: 源氏辞别末摘花，又去探望尼姑空蝉。

en.t: Genji took leave of Suetsumuhana, then went to visit Utsusemi, who had become a nun.

units.source_text: 空蝉不像这邸宅的主人，自己住在一间僻静的小室中，而将大部分房屋供佛。

en.t: Utsusemi did not live like the mistress of this residence; she herself stayed in a quiet little room and dedicated most of the house to Buddhist worship.

units.source_text: 其修行之精勤，令人真心感动。

en.t: The diligence of her religious practice moved one sincerely.

units.source_text: 经卷、佛像的装饰，以至净水杯等细小器物，无不精致雅洁。

en.t: The sutra scrolls, the adornments of the Buddhist images, and even small objects such as the water cups were all refined, graceful, and immaculate.

units.source_text: 令人看了觉得此人品质毕竟与众不同。

en.t: Anyone who saw them would feel that this woman was, after all, of a quality unlike ordinary people.

units.source_text: 空蝉坐在一个意匠工巧的青灰色帷屏后面，只露出一只色彩与青灰相对照的衣袖。

en.t: Utsusemi sat behind an artfully designed blue gray curtain screen, showing only one sleeve whose color contrasted with the blue gray.

units.source_text: 这情景非常美观，源氏看了，不觉流下泪来，对她言道：“你这松浦岛上的渔女，我只能遥遥想念而已。

en.t: The sight was very beautiful, and when Genji saw it, tears came to him unawares; he said to her, "You fisherwoman of Matsura Island, I can only think of you from afar.

units.source_text: 我与你想必自昔结下了恶因缘。

en.t: You and I must have formed an unfortunate bond from long ago.

units.source_text: 到如今总算只有晤谈这一点缘分还没有断绝。”

en.t: Even now, at least this one bond, that we may meet and speak together, has not yet been severed."

units.source_text: 空蝉也深为感慨，答道：“我能蒙你如此关怀，便是深厚的缘分了。”

en.t: Utsusemi too was deeply moved and replied, "To receive such concern from you is itself a profound bond."

units.source_text: 源氏说：“我常反复回想当年之事，总觉得过去屡次使你伤心，应得恶报。

en.t: Genji said, "I often think back again and again on what happened in those days, and I feel that for having hurt you so many times I deserve bitter retribution.

units.source_text: 今我向佛忏悔，中心深感痛苦。

en.t: Now, as I confess before the Buddha, I feel deep anguish in my heart.

units.source_text: 现在你已了解我的心情了么？

en.t: Do you understand my feelings now?

units.source_text: 世间没有像我这样忠诚的人，我想这一点你现在不会不体会到吧。”

en.t: There is no one in the world as faithful as I am, and I think you cannot fail to realize that now."

units.source_text: 空蝉闻言，推想源氏已经知道她为了避免前房儿子纪伊守追求而出家为尼之事，颇觉难以为情，答道：“要你看我这丑陋之相，直到我死为止，已经抵偿了你过去的罪愆，此外还有什么恶报呢？”

en.t: Hearing this, Utsusemi guessed that Genji had learned she had become a nun to avoid the advances of her former husband's son, the Governor of Kii, and feeling deeply embarrassed, she answered, "Having you look upon this ugly form of mine until the day I die has already repaid your past sins. What further punishment could there be?"

units.source_text: 说罢真心地哭起来。

en.t: After saying this, she began to weep from the heart.

units.source_text: 其实空蝉的神态比从前更加清秀了。

en.t: In truth, Utsusemi's bearing was even more pure and graceful than before.

units.source_text: 源氏想起了此人已经斩断情丝，遁入空门，觉得实在难于抛舍。

en.t: Genji thought of how she had already cut the threads of passion and entered the Buddhist path, and he found it truly hard to let her go.

units.source_text: 然而此时岂可再说风流绮语？

en.t: Yet how could he speak amorous, flowery words at such a time?

units.source_text: 只和她谈了些一般的旧话新闻。

en.t: He merely talked with her about ordinary memories of the past and recent news.

units.source_text: 他向末摘花那边望望，想道：“那人总得具有此人那样的优点才好。”

en.t: He looked over toward Suetsumuhana and thought, "If only that woman had some of this woman's virtues."
